method: Read primary papers and official project/documentation pages via web tool. No external training data or research dependencies installed.

sources.title: OCSF schema
sources.decision: 借鉴事件语义和规范化；不当成攻击分类器

sources.title: InterpretML EBM
sources.decision: 候选非线性主效应与有限交互；尚未训练，不保证泛化

sources.title: InterpretML source
sources.decision: 作为下一轮实现候选，不引用其他数据集成绩

sources.title: EBM API
sources.decision: 核查内部验证、bags和关闭早停；防止默认按行划分

sources.title: Missingness shifts
sources.decision: 区分缺失信息与缺失机制；本题机制未知

sources.title: Group DRO
sources.decision: 借鉴最差组检查，不直接上权冲突样本

sources.title: Spurious features under shift
sources.decision: 不充分分组也会使Group DRO失效

sources.title: Noisy labels reliability
sources.decision: 稳健分类损失不保证概率校准

sources.title: Threshold tuning
sources.decision: 模型分数与决策分开；阈值拟合须样本外

sources.title: Sigma specification
sources.decision: 来源条件和误报说明；不将规则命中自动转成官方标签

sources.title: MAPIE risk control
sources.decision: 独立风险输出；交换性等假设不能省略

sources.title: MAPIE exchangeability
sources.decision: 分布变化可破坏统计保证，本题不声称95%可靠

sources.title: Loglizer
sources.decision: 序列窗口需可信关联；本题不虚构时间或IP链

sources.title: Security ML pitfalls
sources.decision: 采样偏差、泄漏及实际使用条件审查

sources.title: Windows event 4672
sources.decision: SYSTEM登录也可产生事件；不能据事件号直接判恶意
